onboarding.intro: Your identity is a keypair generated on this device. There is no server and no phone number verification.
onboarding.nameHint: Shown to people you invite. Just a label, not verified.
onboarding.backupWarn: This key is your identity. If you lose it, you lose your account — there is no reset.
onboarding.privacyTitle: What is private — and what is not
onboarding.privacyBody: Message content is end-to-end encrypted. But relays and network observers can see metadata: that you use relays, when you connect, and who talks to whom. There is no forward secrecy in v1. Telepatty is not anonymous.
onboarding.lockHint: Encrypt your key at rest with a passphrase. You will need it to open the app.
onboarding.iosStorage: iOS note: the installed Home Screen app and Safari have separate storage. Install the app first, then create your account inside the installed app — or move it via encrypted backup later.
onboarding.restoreInvalid: That does not look like a valid nsec key

lock.title: Telepatty is locked
lock.expired: Your session expired. Please unlock again.
lock.hint: Enter your passphrase to decrypt your identity

chats.emptyHint: Add a friend by exchanging your invite link or code.
chats.deleteChatConfirm: Delete this chat and its history from this device? This only affects this device.
chats.clearConfirm: Clear all messages in this chat from this device?
chats.blockedNotice: You blocked this contact. Their messages are dropped silently.

msg.invalidMsg: Received a message that could not be verified
msg.replyUnavailable: Original message is outside the loaded window

friends.title: Friends
friends.inviteHint: Share your invite via any channel. The data is in the link fragment (#) so servers never see it.
friends.noShare: Web Share not available here — use copy instead.
friends.verifyHint: Compare these numbers out of band (in person or another channel). If they match, the connection is authentic.
friends.unfriendConfirm: Remove this friend? You can also delete the chat history. They are not notified; their future messages are ignored unless they send a new request.
friends.blockConfirm: Block and delete chat? Their messages, receipts and requests are dropped silently. They are not told.
friends.rateLimited: Too many requests from this user — ignored.
friends.emptyHint: Exchange invites to add friends. There is no directory — nobody can be searched.
friends.pasteCode: Paste a friend code or invite link
friends.requestsCount: {n} incoming friend request(s) waiting for your answer.
friends.scanningHint: Point the camera at the QR code

permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.notifWhy: Show a local notification when a message arrives while the app is in the background.
permissions.cameraWhy: Used only while the QR scanner is open.
permissions.storageWhy: Prevents the browser from wiping your messages and identity when storage runs low.
permissions.clipboardWhy: Used when you copy invite links or paste friend codes.
permissions.deniedHow: JavaScript cannot re-request a denied permission. Re-enable it in browser site settings: click the lock/site icon in the address bar → Site settings → Notifications → Allow.
permissions.deniedHowAndroid: Chrome/Edge (Android): ⋮ menu → Info → Site settings → Notifications → Allow.
permissions.deniedHowIos: iOS: Settings → Apps → Safari → this site → Notifications → Allow. Notifications only work in the installed PWA.
permissions.noPush: No server means no push when the app is fully closed. Messages arrive when you open the app.
permissions.iosNotInstalled: On iOS, notifications require installing Telepatty to the Home Screen first.
permissions.banner: Turn on notifications to see messages while the app is in the background?
permissions.storageBestEffort: Storage is best-effort — data may be evicted under pressure
permissions.storageNotGranted: Not granted — the browser decides on its own. Installing Telepatty and using it regularly usually turns persistent storage on; asking again rarely changes anything, so we won't nag.
permissions.cameraDeniedHow: Camera is blocked for this site. Re-enable it in the browser's site settings: click the lock/site icon in the address bar → Site settings → Camera → Allow, then press “Check again”.

install.bannerBody: Install the app for a full-screen experience, better storage and faster launch.
install.iosStep1: Tap the Share button in Safari
install.iosStep3: Tap Add — Telepatty appears on your Home Screen
install.stateAvailable: This device can install the app
install.stateUnsupported: Installation not supported in this browser
install.iosNote: On iOS, use Safari's Share → Add to Home Screen.
install.desktopNote: No banner on desktop by design — install from here whenever you like.
install.bannerBodyIos: Add Telepatty to your Home Screen for the full app experience.

prompt.cameraTitle: Allow the camera for QR scanning?
prompt.cameraBody: The camera is used only while the scanner is open. Nothing is recorded or uploaded.
prompt.notifBody: You get a local notification when a message arrives while Telepatty is in the background. No server is involved.
prompt.storageTitle: Keep your data safe from cleanup?
prompt.storageBody: Persistent storage stops the browser from deleting your messages and identity when space runs low. The browser decides — regular use helps.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.accentHint: Overrides the preset's highlight color. The first swatch restores the preset default.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.readReceiptsHint: When off, the other side never sees “read”.
privacy.sessionHint: After this period you must re-enter your passphrase to unlock. Default: 60 days.
privacy.retentionNote: Messages are kept for 3 months, then automatically removed from this device. Per-chat disappearing timers still apply.

relays.title: Relays
relays.hint: Messages are stored on public relays as an encrypted mailbox. Retention is NOT guaranteed — offline messages may expire after days depending on the relay.
relays.minHint: Require sending to at least 3 relays

connection.title: Connection
connection.iceHint: One per line: stun at host:port, turn with user and pass

backup.title: Backup
backup.newerSchema: Backup was made by a newer app version
backup.warn: Keep the passphrase safe — the backup cannot be recovered without it.
backup.includeFilesHint: Adds stored file blobs to the backup. Large — the 5 MB per-file cap still applies.

storageUsage.title: Storage
storageUsage.rebuildHint: Repairs chat previews and unread counters from local messages.

files.title: Files
files.deleteHint: Removes all downloaded/shared file blobs from this device (messages stay).
files.deleteConfirm: Delete ALL stored file blobs from this device? This cannot be undone.

about.title: About
about.honest: Honest limits: no push when closed, relay retention not guaranteed, metadata visible to relays, no forward secrecy.

danger.title: Danger zone
danger.deleteAllConfirm: Delete EVERYTHING on this device (identity, friends, messages, settings)? This cannot be undone.

notifications.updateBody: Update now to get the latest version.

files.originalNote: The original file is sent as-is; metadata (EXIF/GPS) may remain in it.
files.reencodeNote: Photos are resized and re-encoded (max 1600 px) — that removes EXIF/GPS metadata.
files.disabledNoIce: No ICE/TURN servers configured — a direct connection is not possible. Add one under Settings → Connection.
files.bothOnlineRequired: Sending files requires both people to be online at the same time.
files.zipTooBig: The selected files together exceed the 5 MB limit.

errors.relayDown: Relays unreachable — messages stay queued and retry automatically.
errors.decryptFail: A message could not be decrypted (wrong key or corrupted).
errors.storageFull: Storage is full — free space or export a backup.
errors.cameraDenied: Camera access denied. You can paste the friend code instead.
errors.cameraUnsupported: This browser cannot scan QR codes. Paste the code instead.
errors.offline: You are offline — messages will be sent when you reconnect.
errors.minRelays: Not enough relays accepted the message; retrying.
errors.cameraInsecure: The camera needs a secure connection (HTTPS). Paste the code instead.
errors.cameraMissing: No camera was found on this device.
